subject: FIX (compile): integration inert_render_pass_test.m gets an n2r_rt_load_exact stub next to its n2r_bpp stub; gates rerunning now
body: Cause: nord2_render_pass.inc:145 (texture's raw-target DontCare rule) calls n2r_rt_load_exact (static inline in nord2_metal_render.h); the inert test includes the .inc standalone with its own n2r_bpp/n2r_clear stubs. Added 'static unsigned n2r_rt_load_exact(unsigned f){return n2r_bpp(f)!=0;}' there (its stub admits only 10/70/80/115, all load-exact). No production source change. test_blit_completeness: api-surface reported the fence update fixed; my gate run (c6n/gates.sh: iOS syntax x3 + ARM64 bridge/render, integration, render harness, CA PF0/PF1, run_host_tests) is waiting for the lease; I post TREE BUILDS / results when it finishes.
